data.body:
[P2] Reconsider the unused gate callback branches

Rule 4, **Every branch has a test that fails without it**, remains broken: no fixture call or supplied test passes `on_release` or `on_hold`, so deleting both dispatch branches changes no assertion. These hooks expand the fault-timing contract without demonstrated use or coverage. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and narrow the contract to active scenarios, or establish why these hooks are required and how their behavior will be verified.
